integrity: Exact algebraic proof of the full bivariate series and sharp threshold; independent finite word enumeration and a standalone standard-library reproducibility program. Reuses the existing univariate total only as a cross-check, not as a new claim.
scientific_limitations: Noiseless labeled cyclic binary ordered three-gram multisets; no error correction or fiber sizes. A relevant older Markov-type paper was not accessible in full; priority comparison remains qualified.
title: Composition-resolved cyclic binary three-gram profiles and their sharp saturation threshold
